title: Where are our users?
hints: Pipeline: the country column → sort (so equal values sit together) → count → sort the counts high to low.

`printf 'b
a
b
' | sort | uniq -c` prints `1 a` and `2 b`.
`tail -n +2 "$DATA/users.csv" | cut -d, -f5 | sort | uniq -c | ...`: finish with a numeric reverse sort.
